name: enviro-paper
description: Environmental-science paper-writing SKILL COLLECTION for Claude Code and Codex: 1 umbrella orchestrator (enviro-paper) + 9 independently selectable function skills (envsci-ideate, envsci-litsearch, envsci-data, envsci-figures, envsci-writing, envsci-citations, envsci-review, envsci-journals, envsci-slides). Each can be invoked on its own; the umbrella runs the full data->manuscript->response pipeline. Composes with the separate scipilot-figure-skill for general figure methodology.

interface.shortDescription: Environmental-science sampling data to a submission-ready paper
interface.longDescription: Use Enviro Paper to take an environmental-science field-sampling dataset (water, soil, sediment, sludge, pore-water/peeper, air/aerosol, ecology) all the way to a submission-ready manuscript: validate data with QA/QC and non-detect handling, run environmental statistics, compute pollution and ecological/health-risk indices (Igeo, EF, CF/PLI, Hakanson Er/RI, Nemerow, WQI, EPA HQ/HI/CR), generate publication-quality figures, draft and polish IMRaD sections, verify citations against fabrication, simulate peer review, write reviewer-response letters, and format for a target environmental journal. Also generate a journal-spec graphical abstract and a presentation deck.
defaultPrompt: Analyze my sampling data with QA/QC and compute pollution indices.
Make publication-quality figures from these environmental results.
Polish my Methods section to environmental-journal style.
